  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  DECEMBER 8, 2020

  A regular meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor McKeown at 5:30 p.m., on
  Tuesday, December 8, 2020, via teleconference pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 at
  https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/hwjfxves

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Ana Maria Jara
  Councilmember Kristin McCowan
  Councilmember Ted Winterer

  Absent:  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Lane Dilg
  Interim City Attorney George Cardona
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:30 p.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tem O’Day.

  SPECIAL AGENDA  2.A. Adoption of Resolution No. 11309 (CCS) entitled
  ITEMS:  “RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  OFFICIAL CANVASS OF  SANTA MONICA ACCEPTING THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  MUNICIPAL ELECTION  REGISTRAR RECORDER/COUNTY CLERK’S OFFICIAL
  CANVASS AND OFFICIAL STATEMENT OF VOTES CAST FOR
  THE CONSOLIDATED MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD ON
  NOVEMBER 3, 2020, AND DECLARING THE RESULTS
  THEREOF”, was presented.

  Recommended Action:
  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the resolution accepting the
  Official Canvass for the General Municipal Election held on November 3,
  2020.

  Motion by Councilmember Winterer, seconded by Councilmember
  Himmelrich, to adopt Resolution No. 11309 (CCS) accepting the Official
  Canvass for the General Municipal Election held on November 3, 2020.

  1  December 8, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: F48BE58D-4480-4CC5-A3CA-944288D0DBC0

  The motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmember McCowan, Himmelrich, Davis, Winterer, Jara,
  Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: Mayor Pro Tem O’Day

  ADJOURNMENT OF  On order of the Mayor, City Council, as presently constituted, was
  CURRENT COUNCIL  adjourned and the meeting was turned over to the City Clerk Denise
  Anderson-Warrant.

  SANTA MONICA  2.B. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica College
  COLLEGE BOARD OF  Board of Trustees Members, was presented.
  TRUSTEES
  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly-
  elected Community College Board of Trustees Members Susan Aminoff,
  Margaret Quinones-Perez and Rob Greenstein Rader.

  SANTA MONICA  2.C. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica Malibu
  MALIBU UNIFIED  Unified School District Board Members, was presented.
  SCHOOL DISTRICT
  BOARD  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly-
  elected School District Board Members Jon Kean, Maria Leon-Vazquez
  and Jen Smith

  SANTA MONICA RENT  2.D.  Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica Rent
  CONTROL BOARD  Control Board Members, was presented.

  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly-
  elected Rent Control Board Members Caroline Torosis and Anastasia
  Foster.

  SANTA MONICA CITY  2.E. Administration of Oath of Office to New Santa Monica City
  COUNCILMEMBERS  Councilmembers, was presented.

  City Clerk Anderson-Warren administered the oath of office to newly-
  elected Councilmembers Phil Brock, Gleam Olivia Davis, Christine Parra,
  Oscar de la Torre and Kristin McCowan.

  CONVENING OF THE  2.F.  Convening of new City Council, was presented.
  NEW CITY COUNCIL
  AND ELECTION OF  • Roll Call
  MAYOR AND MAYOR
  PRO TEMPORE  PRESENT: Councilmembers McCowan, Himmelrich, Davis, Parra,
  de la Torre, Brock, McKeown

  2  December 8, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: F48BE58D-4480-4CC5-A3CA-944288D0DBC0

  DISCLOSURE  Councilmember McCowan disclosed that earlier today she may have
  inadvertently violated the Brown Act. She called the Interim City Attorney
  to advise him regarding certain conversations she had with other
  Councilmembers regarding the selection of a Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem.
  In accordance with the Interim City Attorney’s advise, she disclosed those
  conversations on the record, in advance of the Council discussion and vote.

  She disclosed, over the last week, in separate, individual conversations, she
  told three other councilpersons that she would be willing to serve as Mayor
  Pro Tem, something that she also stated publicly. Over the last week, in
  separate, individual conversations, she also told those same councilpersons
  that she would be supporting Sue Himmelrich to serve as Mayor.
  Something that she has also stated publicly. She wanted to be sure that
  these conversations were disclosed publicly, prior to the Council
  proceeding with the public discussion and votes on the Mayor and Mayor
  Pro Tem.

  MAYOR SELECTION  • Election of Mayor for the ensuing two years

  The City Clerk opened the floor for nominations for electin of Mayoor for
  the ensuing two years.

  Councilmember McKeown, nominated Councilmember Davis for the first
  year, and Councilmember Himmelrich for the second year.

  Councilmember Himmelrich declined the nomination.

  Councilmember McKeown, amended his nomination to Councilmember
  Davis for Mayor and Councilmember McCowan for Mayor Pro Tem.

  Councilmember Parra, nominated Councilmember Himmelrich for Mayor,
  and Councilmember Brock for Mayor Pro Tem

  Councilmember McCowan, nominated Councilmember Himmelrich for
  Mayor for two years.

  The City Clerk announced that nominations and votes will only be for the
  Mayor, and the Mayor Pro Tem will be done separately.

  Councilmember de la Torre, nominated Councilmember Brock for Mayor.

  There being no other nominations, no one received enough votes to be
  selected Mayor by the following votes:

  DAVIS:  Councilmembers Davis, McKeown
  HIMMELRICH: Councilmembers Himmerich, McCowan

  3  December 8, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: F48BE58D-4480-4CC5-A3CA-944288D0DBC0

  BROCK:  Councilmembers Brock, de la Torre, Parra

  With there being no selection, the City Clerk opened the floor to
  nominations for Round 2.

  Councilmember McKeown, nominated Councilmember Davis for the first
  year, and Councilmember Himmelrich for the second year.

  Councilmember Himmelrich declined the nomination.

  Councilmember McCowan, nominated Councilmember Himmelrich for
  two years.

  Councilmember de la Torre, nominated Councilmember Himmelrich for
  the first year, and Councilmember McCowan for the second year.

  Councilmember McCowan declined the nomination.

  Councilmember McKeown, nominated Councilmember Davis

  Councilmember Brock, nominated himself for one year, and
  Councilmember de la Torre for the second year.

  There being no other nominations, no one received enough votes to be
  selected Mayor by the following votes:

  DAVIS:  Councilmembers Davis, McKeown
  HIMMELRICH:  Councilmembers Himmerich, McCowan
  BROCK/DE LA TORRE: Councilmembers Brock, de la Torre, Parra

  With there being no selection, the City Clerk opened the floor to
  nominations for Round 3.

  Councilmember McKeown, nominated Councilmember Davis for the first
  year, and Councilmember Himmelrich for the second year.

  Councilmember Himmelrich declined the nomination.

  Councilmember McCowan, nominated Councilmember Himmelrich for
  two years.

  Councilmember de la Torre, nominated Councilmember Himmelrich for
  the first year, and Councilmember Brock for the second year.

  Councilmember Himmelrich declined the nomination for one year.

  4  December 8, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: F48BE58D-4480-4CC5-A3CA-944288D0DBC0

  Councilmember McKeown, nominated Councilmember Davis

  Councilmember de la Torre, pulled his nomination, with Councilmember
  Himmelrich’s decline.

  There being no other nominations, Councilmember Himmelrich was
  selected as the Mayor by the following vote:

  DAVIS:  Councilmembers Davis, McKeown
  HIMMELRICH: Councilmembers Brock, de la Torre, Parra, Himmelrich,
  McCowan

  MAYOR PRO TEMPORE  • Election of Mayor Pro Tem for the ensuing two years
  SELECTION

  END OF INSTALLATION OF NEW OFFICERS

  The Mayor opened the floor for nominations for the Mayor Pro Tem
  selection.

  Councilmember Davis, nominated Councilmember McCowan for two
  years.

  Councilmember de la Torre, nominated Councilmember Brock for two
  years.

  Councilmember Himmelrich nominated Councilmember McCowan for the
  first year, and Councilmember Parra for the second year.

  Councilmember McCowan declined the nomination to serve for one year.
  Councilmember Parra also declined the nomination to serve for one year.

  Councilmember Himmelrich, nominated Councilmembers McCowan and
  de la Torre.

  Councilmember McCowan declined the nomination to serve for one year.
  Councilmember de la Torre declined the nomination, and stayed with his
  original nomination.

  There being no other nominations, Councilmember McCowan was selected
  as the Mayor Pro Tem by the following vote:

  MCCOWAN: Councilmembers McCowan, Himmelrich, Davis, McKeown
  BROCK:  Councilmembers Parra, de la Torre, Brock

  5  December 8, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: F48BE58D-4480-4CC5-A3CA-944288D0DBC0

  PUBLIC INPUT:  Members of the public Denise Barton, Carlo de la Cruz, Olga Zurawska,
  Adrian Martinez commented on various local issues.
